womens-health-integrative-care.title: PCOS, Period & Menopause Treatment in Khanvel, Silvassa | Suvacha

faqs.a: Yes. PCOS care at Suvacha includes hormonal and ultrasound evaluation, lifestyle and diet planning, medical treatment where needed, and supportive Ayurvedic therapies to help regulate cycles and improve metabolic health.

faqs.q: When should I see a gynecologist for irregular periods?
faqs.a: See a gynecologist if your cycles are regularly shorter than 21 days or longer than 35 days, you miss periods for three months, bleeding is very heavy or lasts more than 7 days, or you have bleeding between periods or after menopause.

Yes. We help with hot flashes, sleep and mood changes, bone and heart health, and lifestyle planning during perimenopause and menopause, combining medical evaluation with diet, yoga and Ayurvedic support.

faqs.q: Can I consult a lady doctor?

pregnancy-maternal-care.title: Pregnancy Care & Normal Delivery in Khanvel, Silvassa | Suvacha
pregnancy-maternal-care.description: Antenatal check-ups, pregnancy scans, high-risk pregnancy care, normal & caesarean delivery and postnatal support in Khanvel near Silvassa.

faqs.a: Yes. We strongly support normal delivery whenever it is medically safe, with continuous labour monitoring. A caesarean section is advised only when it is medically indicated for the safety of mother or baby.

faqs.q: When should I have my first pregnancy visit?
faqs.a: As soon as your pregnancy test is positive — ideally by 6–8 weeks. The first visit confirms the pregnancy, dates it with an ultrasound and starts essential supplements and blood tests.

faqs.q: Which scans are needed during pregnancy?
faqs.a: Typically an early pregnancy scan (6–8 weeks), NT scan (11–13 weeks), anomaly scan (18–20 weeks) and growth scans in the third trimester. Use our free due date planner to see your own scan dates.

faqs.q: Which conditions can be treated surgically?

faqs.q: How many days does Panchakarma take?
